```plato
    // Component-wise remainder. Precondition: no component of b is zero.
    Modulo(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x % y);
```

## Line 60

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/numeric-structures.library.plato, line 60](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/numeric-structures.library.plato#L60).

```plato

    // Every component reduced modulo a unitless scalar. Precondition: non-zero.
    Modulo(self: IVector, scalar: Number): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x % scalar);
```
